definitions.explanation: Acting on one's own initiative without being directed or compelled by others. Used as a modifier to describe activities, organizations, or decisions made independently.

examples.japanese: {自主|じしゅ}{練習|れんしゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{励|はげ}む→励む：11822_hagemu⟧。
examples.english: To work hard at independent practice.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{自主|じしゅ}⟦{回収|かいしゅう}→回収：03019_kaishuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}めた→決める：00858_kimeru⟧。
examples.english: The company decided on a voluntary recall of the product.

examples.japanese: ⟦{生徒|せいと}→生徒：01051_seito⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{自主的|じしゅてき}→自主的：17149_jishuteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{校庭|こうてい}→校庭：04147_koutei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{清掃|せいそう}→清掃：04332_seisou⟧⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}った→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: The students voluntarily carried out a cleanup of the schoolyard.

notes:
USAGE:
Almost always used as a modifier: {自主|じしゅ}～ (noun compound) or ⟦{自主的|じしゅてき}→自主的：17149_jishuteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (adverbial). Implies initiative and self-motivation. In Japanese society, {自主|じしゅ} actions are generally viewed positively as showing maturity and responsibility.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自主|じしゅ}{練習|れんしゅう}: independent practice
- {自主|じしゅ}⟦{回収|かいしゅう}→回収：03019_kaishuu⟧: voluntary recall
- {自主|じしゅ}⟦{規制|きせい}→規制：02598_kisei⟧: voluntary regulation, self-censorship
- ⟦{自主的|じしゅてき}→自主的：17149_jishuteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: voluntarily, on one's own initiative
- {自主|じしゅ}⟦{退職|たいしょく}→退職：04559_taishoku⟧: voluntary resignation
- {自主|じしゅ}⟦{制作|せいさく}→制作：04320_seisaku⟧: independent production
